newsitem.title: SPAIN: Key elements in proposed EU position on Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Key elements in proposed EU position on Cuba.

text.p: These are the key points of a common position on Cuba which Spain expects European Union foreign ministers to approve at a meeting on December 6:

-- The EU's main aim is to encourage Cuba to move towards democracy and the respect of human rights and basic freedoms. The transition is more likely to be peaceful if it is launched by the current government.
-- The EU recognises early steps towards economic liberalisation in Cuba and wants to be a partner in a more permanent opening of its economy.

-- To promote peaceful change in Cuba, the EU will: increase contacts with Cuban authorities and all sectors of society; take every opportunity to remind Cuba in public and in private of its human rights responsibilities; push for the release of political prisoners and an end to harassment of dissidents; provide essential humanitarian aid and consider economic aid.
-- As Cuban authorities make progress towards democracy, the EU will intensify its political dialogue with Havana and step up economic cooperation.
-- An EU-Cuba cooperation agreement could be considered in the longer term.
